answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the sonnet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Each submission hangs on the cedar of a task receipt, and the knoll is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
